btnSelect: Takes the airfield picked. On the DataCard it fills the row: TACAN, elevation, tower frequencies, the runway into the wind and its ILS. On the DTC page, the RADIO/NAV airport.
btnCancel: Closes the window; the airport stays as it was.
cboCountry: Narrows the list below. On the DataCard: the theater's fields by kind (All airfields, airbases, airstrips…). From the DTC page: the theater Falcon BMS is on.
cboAirports: The airfield to use, by name, from the app's airport data for the theater.
